title: Administration SUCCESS audit survives rollback of user/role changes
environment: Disposable local PostgreSQL18.6 only; no UATfaultinjection
preconditions: Canonical exactSHA jar; own synthetic user/role; administrator
Snapshot full business rows/role memberships internally, publish equality only
steps: Create an owned synthetic user; snapshot app_user/user_role; count USER_UPDATE SUCCESS events.

Install only in disposableDB: create function qa_audit_tx_fault() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'QA transaction audit fault'; end $$; create constraint trigger qa_audit_tx_fault after update on app_user deferrable initially deferred for each row when (NEW.id='<ownedUserId>'::uuid) execute function qa_audit_tx_fault();
After500,compare business snapshot and SUCCESS audit delta; remove trigger/function.

Equivalent restricted INSERT/UPDATE fault reproduces other actions; role_permission BEFOREINSERT failure duringroleedit proves earlier ROLE_UPDATE success also survives immediate dependent-write rollback.
expected: Rolled-back changes add no SUCCESS event. Legitimate security FAILURE/DENIED events remain independently durable.
actual: 10independent failing checks; business snapshots unchanged, corresponding SUCCESS delta+1 (rolepermission edit+1 forboth ROLE_UPDATE andROLE_PERMISSIONS_CHANGE). Immediate dependentwritefailure leavesROLE_UPDATE+1 andROLE_PERMISSIONS_CHANGE0.
cause: UserAdministration.record andRoleAdministration.record call REQUIRES_NEW AuditLog.record inside outer business transaction.

independent_retests.note: Alladministrative SUCCESS events roll back with businessCOMMIT/dependent-write/audit-insert failures; retries produce one event; concurrentversion loser noevent; last-admin races safe. Normalwrites/auditbrowser onUAT. Faultinjection local only.
